instruction: Launch Visual Studio Code and open the README.md file located in /home/user/project/.

command: cd /home/user/Downloads && unzip -q vscodeEvalExtension.zip && code --install-extension vscodeEvalExtension/eval-0.0.1.vsix && rm -rf vscodeEvalExtension vscodeEvalExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening VSCode and then opening the README.md file from the project folder. The evaluator uses a custom VSCode extension command 'GetOpenFile' to retrieve the currently open file (which implicitly verifies VSCode is active, as only VSCode can respond to extension commands) and checks if the full path '/home/user/project/README.md' is open. This is similar in complexity to the original task which opens a project folder.
